description: This source file defines an interface named ShoppingCartFacade that provides an abstract layer for shopping cart operations in an e-commerce system. It contains method signatures related to creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting shopping cart data, acting as a bridge between core business logic and controller layers.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacade
classes.description: An interface providing abstraction for shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating, and retrieving shopping cart data.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart for a specific customer, store, language, with exception handling.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new ShoppingCart object based on a shopping cart code, store, and customer.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data based on customer, store, and shopping cart ID.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Overloaded method to get shopping cart data directly from a ShoppingCart object.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Overloaded method to get shopping cart data using a code and store.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart using item ID, cart ID, store, and language context.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item based on item ID, cart ID, store, and language.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes the entire shopping cart identified by ID and store.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple shopping cart items for a store and language context.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart model based on cart code and store.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart model for a specific customer and store.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Overloaded method to delete shopping cart by code and store.
